cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our school trip now needs two signatures on every consent form. Reassuring. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good. Independent eyes before any child boards a bus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. We've found a safeguard our second safeguard needed. Who's checking that third person?
